newsitem.title: UK: EBRD plans four venture funds for Ukraine.
newsitem.headline: EBRD plans four venture funds for Ukraine.

text.p: The European Bank for Reconstruction and Development plans to set up four new regional venture funds for Ukraine, a senior official said on Monday.
Stig Hegstad, director of the Early Stage Equity Team at the EBRD, told a seminar at the bank's annual conference some finance for the funds had already been secured.

"We are aiming to set up four regional venture funds (RVFs) in Ukraine. We have alreday got funding from the Spanish government, 20 million ECU for the first fund, and funding from the Dutch government, $10 million, for the second fund," he said.
The EBRD also hoped for funding from the European Union.
Hegstad said two of the funds should be operational early netx year and the other two late in 1997.
The EBRD, set up to help former communist states in the transition to market economies, already has 11 RVFs in Russia with total equity of $338 million.
